tools.name: search_documentation
tools.description:
Search ALL JobMojito documentation. This is the single entry point.

One call searches both documentation sources in parallel and returns a
merged, source-labeled list — you do not need to choose a source or call
a separate tool:
  • "developer" — developer.jobmojito.com: API reference, request/resp

tools.name: get_documentation
tools.description:
Fetch the full content of a single JobMojito documentation page.

Accepts a URL returned by `search_documentation`. For developer docs the
clean Markdown (.md) variant is fetched automatically. Only
developer.jobmojito.com and help.jobmojito.com URLs are allowed.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_documentation" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search ALL JobMojito documentation. This is the single entry point. One call searches both documentation sources in parallel and returns a merged, source-labele…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "create_persona" is 2532 chars, far longer than this server's median (299). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.detail: Description of "create_persona" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_documentation, get_documentation, create_persona, get_interview_result_details, list_languages · Private data: create_persona, generate_interview_url, list_interviews, list_interview_results, get_merchant_analytics, get_merchant_credit_usage, list_candidates, upload_knowledge_base_document, list_sub_merchants, list_avatars, get_merchant_status · Public sink: create_persona, upload_knowledge_base_document · Destructive: list_my_merchants.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_documentation, get_documentation, create_persona, get_interview_result_details, list_languages · Private data: create_persona, generate_interview_url, list_interviews, list_interview_results, get_merchant_analytics, get_merchant_credit_usage, list_candidates, upload_knowledge_base_document, list_sub_merchants, list_avatars, get_merchant_status · Public sink: create_persona, upload_knowledge_base_document · Destructive: list_my_merchants

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
